evidence: After the mandated-PATH command `PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" ffprobe ...` returned "Exit code 127 (eval):1: command not found: ffprobe", the run switched to `PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" /opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe ...` and later `/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg ...` to inspect the render and cut the cover image, reaching the encoder/prober outside the job's stated PATH environment by absolute path instead of stopping and telling the user the toolchain was unavailable.
